verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Bitwarden's integrated authenticator producing only standard TOTPs: six-digit, SHA-1 codes that rotate every 30 seconds. Nothing in the pack documents Steam Guard codes, HOTP counter-based tokens, or configurable periods and digit lengths. The axis clearly applies to a password manager with a built-in authenticator, so the lack of evidence makes this "none".

support.subject: As a power user, non-standard tokens work too — Steam Guard, HOTP counters, custom periods and digit lengths
